Bio

Romana Rogoshewska, Ph.D. in English literature and language, is an artist and writer. She specializes in full-length portraits and large-scale triptych paintings for corporate, institutional and private collections, including portraits of celebrities and public figures.

EducationPh.D., English literature & language
International background15 years of marriage to a member of the British Royal Family
CareerForensic linguist at the UN, Geneva
SpecialtyFull-length portraits & large-scale triptychs
